cobblemon.species.pink_corvisquire.name: Corvislight
mawonna.species.pink_corvisquire.desc: Its pink ribbon feathers flutter as it watches over its companions.
cobblemon.species.covislight.name: Corvislight
cobblemon.species.covislight.desc: A female Corvisquire can evolve into Corvislight after personally defeating 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in wild or NPC-trainer battles (human PvP never counts). Use the evolution option when available. All Fairy, Flying, and wing attack moves are available from level 1.
cobblemon.species.corvisquire.mawonna_ev: Female Corvisquire can evolve into Corvislight after personally defeating 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in wild or NPC-trainer battles (human PvP never counts). Its normal Corviknight evolution remains available.
cobblemon.species.mawile.mawonna_evoluti: Each Mawile must eat 49 different qualifying prepared meals and personally defeat 666 Dark-type Pokemon in wild or NPC-trainer battles. Human PvP never counts. Then marry your own Mawile using a Mawilite Vow Ring and choose its public Mawonna evolution. The Flower admin form is never obtained through evolution.
cobblemon.species.mawonna.name: Mawonna
cobblemon.species.mawonna.desc: Each Mawile must eat 49 different qualifying prepared meals and personally defeat 666 Dark-type Pokemon in wild or NPC-trainer battles. Human PvP never counts. Then marry your own Mawile using a Mawilite Vow Ring and choose its public Mawonna evolution. The Flower admin form is never obtained through evolution. Public stats: HP 100, Atk 120, Def 120, Sp. Atk 10, Sp. Def 100, Speed 10.
cobblemon.species.mawonna_flower.name: Mawonna Flower
cobblemon.species.mawonna_flower.desc: ADMIN VERSION. Available through the mawonna_flower spawn identifier only; no normal evolution leads here. Retains the original powerful stats and Futakuchi-onna lowering opposing Attack and Sp. Atk by two stages.
cobblemon.ability.futakuchionnaplayer.de: On entering battle, lowers each opposing Pokemon's Attack and Sp. Atk by one stage.
cobblemon.species.mawonnaflower.name: Mawonna Flower
cobblemon.species.mawonnaflower.desc: ADMIN VERSION. Available through the mawonna_flower spawn identifier only; no normal evolution leads here. Retains the original powerful stats and Futakuchi-onna lowering opposing Attack and Sp. Atk by two stages.

cobblemon.species.fairysliggoo.name: Fairy Sliggoo
cobblemon.species.fairy_sliggoo.name: Fairy Sliggoo
cobblemon.species.fairysliggoo.desc: Sliggoo evolves into Fairy Sliggoo after personally defeating 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in wild or NPC-trainer battles (human PvP never counts). Select the evolution when available. This Fairy/Dragon final evolution flies with four fluffy Cupid wings. HP 200, Atk 10, Def 120, Sp. Atk 120, Sp. Def 110, Speed 15.
cobblemon.species.sliggoo.fairy_evolutio: Sliggoo evolves into Fairy Sliggoo after personally defeating 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in wild or NPC-trainer battles (human PvP never counts). Select the evolution when available. This Fairy/Dragon final evolution flies with four fluffy Cupid wings. HP 200, Atk 10, Def 120, Sp. Atk 120, Sp. Def 110, Speed 15.
cobblemon.ability.inkylove.desc: A touch of love leaves a sticky stain. When a damaging move makes contact, its clinging ink lowers the attacker's Speed by one stage.
cobblemon.ability.taintedcharm.desc: A sweet smile hides a dangerous devotion. An opposite-gender attacker that makes damaging contact is always infatuated, unless protected from contact effects or attraction. Same-gender and genderless Pokemon are unaffected.
cobblemon.species.inkyeon.name: Inkyeon
cobblemon.species.inkyeon.desc: Inkyeon is a Fairy/Dark evolution of Sylveon, reached when that individual has exactly 0 friendship (happiness) and has personally defeated at least 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in wild or NPC-trainer battles (human PvP never counts). Both requirements must be met. Its regular Fairy, Dark, tail, sound, speed and ink/liquid-themed moves are available from level 1.
cobblemon.species.sylveon.inkyeon_evolut: Sylveon can evolve into Inkyeon when it has exactly 0 friendship (happiness) and has personally defeated at least 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in wild or NPC-trainer battles (human PvP never counts). Both requirements must be met.
cobblemon.ability.futakuchisgrasp.desc: Her hungry tresses seize those who strike her. When hit by a damaging contact move, this Pokemon lowers the attacker's Attack by one stage.
